subject: Request: endorsement memo & evidence closure for engineering level change
messages:
From: rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai
To: laura.bennett@redwood.ai, jonas.weber@redwood.ai
Cc: 
Date: 2026-05-03T09:13:00-07:00
Subject: Request: endorsement memo & evidence closure for engineering level change

Hi Laura / Jonas,

As discussed in last week's 1:1s, I'm preparing an endorsement memo for Priya Shah's level change consideration (IC3 -> IC4). I've attached a draft memo and a short evidence checklist. Before I route to the committee coordinator, I need help closing a couple of gaps so we have a defensible packet: 

- Concrete product impact examples: I have two shipped stories called out but need one more example with clear before/after metrics (latency or revenue proxy).
- Cross-team endorsements: Sara (Orbit Analytics) volunteered a short quote but hasn't confirmed wording.
- Skip-level calibration: need a one-paragraph calibration note from Director (Jonas) aligning Priya to the rubric.

Timeline: committee window opens week of May 18. Can we lock final packets by EOD May 7 to make the cutoff? If we can't fully close the last example I propose we include an explicit mitigation note in the memo and escalate to the committee for fast-track review.

Attachments: [Attachment: endorsement_draft.docx (docx, 84KB)], [Attachment: evidence_checklist.xlsx (xlsx, 26KB)]

Ask: Laura — do you sign the endorsement as written if we add the missing example? Jonas — can you provide the one-paragraph calibration note and any additional examples by EOD May 5? I'll follow up with Sara for the external quote.

Thanks,
Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Staff SWE, Product Infrastructure
Redwood Inference
From: laura.bennett@redwood.ai
To: rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai, jonas.weber@redwood.ai
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-05-03T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: endorsement memo & evidence closure for engineering level change

Thanks for pulling this together, Rishi — good framing. A few quick asks before I can endorse as-is: 

- Examples need concrete impact statements (e.g., reduced median latency 18% on ingest path; estimated ARR impact $XXk). Put the metric and the time window next to each bullet.
- Add manager calibration: line up Priya against the rubric bullets and note stretch areas. One paragraph from Jonas is fine; I will include a short note as well.
- External quote: please get Sara to email an endorsement that we can paste into the packet (no >3 sentences). If we can't get it by May 5, include a placeholder and mark as "pending external confirmation."

Marissa — can you hold a tentative committee slot for the week of May 18 and advise on blackout dates? If we finalize by May 7 we should be able to fit Priya on the May 19 roster. I'm attaching a calibration template that helps make manager notes uniform.

[Attachment: calibration_template.docx (docx, 12KB)]

If we hit the asks above I'm happy to sign the endorsement.

- Laura
Laura Bennett
VP, Engineering
Redwood Inference

> As discussed in last week's 1:1s, I'm preparing an endorsement memo for Priya Shah's level change consideration (IC3 -> IC4).
>

Thanks, Rishi. Quick notes and one concrete example below — I'll add the second example tomorrow morning before EOD.

Example (short):
- Feature: telemetry-aggregator rewrite (Q4 2025) — reduced median processing latency from 520ms to 410ms for the top 90th percentile of events; reduced pipeline cost ~12% on the ingest cluster. Primary contributor: Priya led the design and owned rollout.

Calibration paragraph (draft):
"Priya consistently designs for scale and has demonstrated ownership across cross-functional execution. Against the IC4 rubric she shows strengths in system design and cross-team influence; primary growth area is proactive roadmap tradeoffs at the org level. I support elevation pending one more high-impact example and a short external confirmation from Orbit Analytics."

Attachment: [Attachment: example_playbook.pdf (pdf, 220KB)]

I'll push a second example by EOD May 5.

— Jonas
From: marissa.cole@redwood.ai

Subject: Committee scheduling & finalization checklist — Priya Shah packet

Hi team,

Thanks for the updates. I've tentatively held these committee windows: May 19 10:00-11:30 PT and May 21 14:00-15:30 PT. Please confirm which you prefer by EOD May 7. We need final packets by 23:59 PT on May 7 to make the May 19 slot.

Checklist to finalize before submission: 
- Endorsement memo (signed by reviewer lead) [Attachment present]
- Manager calibration paragraph (Jonas) [Confirm posted to Drive]
- External quote from Orbit Analytics (Sara) or explicit "pending" placeholder
- Evidence folder: code links, RFCs, postmortems, performance dashboards (link below)
- One-line exec summary (<=3 sentences) for committee read-ahead

I've attached a calendar event suggestion and placed a placeholder folder in Drive for the packet: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBv-example-evidence

If any of the items will miss the May 7 deadline, flag me and we can discuss requesting a late submission — note that late packets are deprioritized and will require an escalation to Laura.

Attachments: [Attachment: committee_window-proposal.ics (calendar)]

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior People Operations Partner
Redwood Inference
